name: Deep-Space Dotted Globe Hero

description.zh: 纯黑背景上以点阵构成深蓝地球，外发光晕与细轨道弧线环绕；左侧为白色标题与四张半透明深灰数据卡，卡片带浅色描边和微弱内发光，主按钮为电光蓝胶囊配2px同色外环。
description.en: A pure-black hero with a dotted deep-blue globe wrapped in a soft cyan halo and thin orbital arcs. Left side stacks a white headline, muted grey subcopy, and four translucent dark stat cards with hairline borders and faint inner glow; the primary CTA is an electric-blue pill with a 2px same-hue ring.

reconstructionPrompt: Build a dark hero section on #000000. Center a pill badge with 1px white border, then a 48-56px white Geist headline and a #a1a1a1 subline. Add two CTAs: primary pill bg #0084d1, white 16px/500 text, radius 14px, padding 0 24px, box-shadow 0 0 0 2px #0084d1, transition transform 0.2s; secondary ghost pill with transparent bg, 1px #ffffff33 border, radius 14px, plus a right arrow. Below, a 2x2 grid of stat cards: bg rgba(255,255,255,0.04), 1px #ffffff1a border, radius 16px, icon + label row then a bold 40px value. Right column holds a dotted-globe image with a radial cyan glow and slowly rotating orbit arcs (CSS keyframes, ~40s linear infinite).
